title: AFLP RedTaq Protocol
author: Michal Ronikier
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rpvd5n6

steps.title: Prepare restriction‑ligation mix
steps.instruction: Mix water, 10× T4 DNA Ligase buffer, BSA (1 mg ml⁻¹), NaCl (0.5 M), Adapter MseI (50 µM), Adapter EcoRI (5 µM), MseI (10 U µl⁻¹), EcoRI (20 U µl⁻¹), and T4 DNA Ligase (5 U µl⁻¹) in the desired volumes.

steps.title: Combine DNA with ligation mix
steps.instruction: Add 6 µl of genomic DNA to 6 µl of the restriction‑ligation mix prepared above.

steps.title: Ligate adapters
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 3 h, then at 17 °C overnight.

steps.title: Dilute ligated DNA
steps.instruction: Dilute the ligated DNA fragments ten‑fold with water.

steps.title: Prepare pre‑selective PCR mix
steps.instruction: Mix water, RedTaq Buffer (10×), dNTPs (2.5 mM each), pre‑selective primer Eco‑A (10 µM), pre‑selective primer Mse‑C (10 µM), and Sigma RedTaq (1 U µl⁻¹).

steps.title: Set up pre‑selective PCR
steps.instruction: Add 2 µl of the 10× diluted restriction‑ligation product to 8 µl of the pre‑selective PCR mix (final volume 10 µl).

steps.title: Perform pre‑selective PCR
steps.instruction: Run the program: 72 °C for 2 min; 25 cycles of 94 °C for 1 s, 56 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 120 s; then 60 °C for 30 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dilute pre‑selective product
steps.instruction: Dilute the pre‑selective PCR product ten‑fold with water.

steps.title: Prepare selective PCR mix
steps.instruction: Mix water, RedTaq Buffer (10×), dNTPs (2.5 mM each), Sigma RedTaq (1 U µl⁻¹), selective primer Mse‑Cxx (5 µM), and selective primer Eco‑Axx (1 µM).

steps.title: Set up selective PCR
steps.instruction: Add 2 µl of the 10× diluted pre‑selective PCR product to 8 µl of the selective PCR mix (final volume 10 µl).

steps.title: Perform selective PCR
steps.instruction: Run the program: 94 °C for 2 min; 10 cycles of 94 °C for 1 s, 65 °C for 30 s with a –1 °C per step ramp down to 56 °C, 72 °C for 120 s; then 22 cycles of 94 °C for 1 s, 56 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 120 s; then 60 °C for 30 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dilute selective product
steps.instruction: Dilute the selective PCR product ten‑fold with water.

steps.title: Purify and analyze fragments
steps.instruction: Purify the diluted product using the Sephadex protocol and load the purified fragments onto an ABI 3130 capillary electrophoresis instrument.
